### `messages`

**Purpose:** Logical message content. status is a projection of the latest delivery attempt (see message_deliveries). Never log or copy body outside this table.

| Column | Type | Required | Default | Key / reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | gen_random_uuid() | PK |
| `conversation_id` | uuid | yes |  | FK → conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `seq` | bigint | yes |  |  |
| `channel` | text | yes |  |  |
| `direction` | text | yes |  |  |
| `sender_user_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `sender_phone` | e164 | no |  |  |
| `body` | text | no |  |  |
| `body_truncated` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `encoding` | text | no |  |  |
| `char_count` | integer | no |  |  |
| `segment_count` | smallint | no |  |  |
| `status` | text | yes |  |  |
| `status_version` | integer | yes | 1 |  |
| `idempotency_key` | uuid | no |  |  |
| `request_hash` | text | no |  |  |
| `is_simulated` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `is_ai_assisted` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `ai_assistance_log_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → ai_assistance_logs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `capability_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → sms_country_capabilities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `credit_cost_units` | bigint | no |  |  |
| `suppressed_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `suppressed_reason` | text | no |  |  |
| `edited_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `deleted_for_everyone_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `admin_resolved_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `admin_resolved_by` | uuid | no |  | FK → profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `admin_resolution_note` | text | no |  |  |
| `search_vector` | tsvector | no | generated: to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, COALESCE(body, ''::text)) |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |

**Unique rules**

- `uq_messages_conversation_seq`: `UNIQUE (conversation_id, seq)`
- `uq_messages_sender_idempotency`: `USING btree (sender_user_id, idempotency_key) WHERE (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)`

**Check constraints**

- `ck_messages_admin_resolution`: `((((admin_resolved_at IS NULL) = (admin_resolution_note IS NULL)) AND ((admin_resolved_at IS NULL) OR (admin_resolved_by IS NOT NULL)) AND ((admin_resolved_at IS NULL) OR (channel = 'sms'::text))))`
- `ck_messages_ai_outbound`: `(((NOT is_ai_assisted) OR (direction = 'outbound'::text)))`
- `ck_messages_body_length`: `(((body IS NULL) OR (char_length(body) <= CASE channel WHEN 'chikka'::text THEN 2000 ELSE 1600 END)))`
- `ck_messages_body_presence`: `((((deleted_for_everyone_at IS NULL) AND (body IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(body) >= 1)) OR ((deleted_for_everyone_at IS NOT NULL) AND (body IS NULL))))`
- `ck_messages_channel`: `((channel = ANY (ARRAY['chikka'::text, 'sms'::text])))`
- `ck_messages_char_count`: `(((char_count IS NULL) OR (char_count >= 0)))`
- `ck_messages_chikka_no_sms_fields`: `(((channel = 'sms'::text) OR ((encoding IS NULL) AND (segment_count IS NULL) AND (capability_id IS NULL) AND (credit_cost_units IS NULL) AND (NOT is_simulated))))`
- `ck_messages_chikka_outbound`: `(((channel = 'sms'::text) OR (direction = 'outbound'::text)))`
- `ck_messages_cost`: `(((credit_cost_units IS NULL) OR (credit_cost_units >= 0)))`
- `ck_messages_delete_chikka`: `(((deleted_for_everyone_at IS NULL) OR (channel = 'chikka'::text)))`
- `ck_messages_direction`: `((direction = ANY (ARRAY['outbound'::text, 'inbound'::text])))`
- `ck_messages_edit_chikka`: `(((edited_at IS NULL) OR (channel = 'chikka'::text)))`
- `ck_messages_encoding`: `(((encoding IS NULL) OR (encoding = ANY (ARRAY['gsm7'::text, 'ucs2'::text]))))`
- `ck_messages_idempotency`: `(((direction = 'inbound'::text) OR (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)))`
- `ck_messages_received_status`: `(((direction = 'inbound'::text) = (status = 'received'::text)))`
- `ck_messages_segments`: `(((segment_count IS NULL) OR ((segment_count >= 1) AND (segment_count <= 10))))`
- `ck_messages_sender`: `((((direction = 'outbound'::text) AND (sender_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (sender_phone IS NULL)) OR ((direction = 'inbound'::text) AND (sender_user_id IS NULL) AND (sender_phone IS NOT NULL))))`
- `ck_messages_sms_outbound_segments`: `(((NOT ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (direction = 'outbound'::text))) OR ((encoding IS NOT NULL) AND (segment_count IS NOT NULL) AND (char_count IS NOT NULL))))`
- `ck_messages_status`: `((((channel = 'chikka'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['sent'::text, 'delivered'::text, 'read'::text, 'failed'::text]))) OR ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'retrying'::text, 'accepted'::text, 'sent'::text, 'delivered'::text, 'undelivered'::text, 'failed'::text, 'received'::text])))))`
- `ck_messages_suppressed`: `(((suppressed_at IS NULL) = (suppressed_reason IS NULL)))`
- `ck_messages_suppressed_reason`: `(((suppressed_reason IS NULL) OR (suppressed_reason = ANY (ARRAY['blocked'::text, 'recipient_unavailable'::text]))))`

**Foreign keys**

- `fk_messages_admin_resolver`: `(admin_resolved_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `fk_messages_ai_log`: `(ai_assistance_log_id) REFERENCES ai_assistance_logs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
- `fk_messages_capability`: `(capability_id) REFERENCES sms_country_capabilities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `fk_messages_conversation`: `(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `fk_messages_sender`: `(sender_user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`

**Indexes**

- `idx_messages_search`: `USING gin (search_vector)`
- `idx_messages_sender`: `USING btree (sender_user_id) WHERE (sender_user_id IS NOT NULL)`
- `idx_messages_sms_queue`: `USING btree (status, created_at) WHERE ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'retrying'::text])))`
- `idx_messages_sms_send_rate`: `USING btree (sender_user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (direction = 'outbound'::text))`

**Triggers**

- `trg_messages_assign_seq`: BEFORE INSERT → private.assign_message_seq()
- `trg_messages_protect_identity`: BEFORE UPDATE → private.protect_message_identity()
- `trg_messages_updated_at`: BEFORE UPDATE → private.set_updated_at()

**Row Level Security:** enabled. Policies: `messages_select_member` (select).

## Delivery and SMS

### `message_deliveries`

**Purpose:** One row per delivery attempt. A retry is a new row with attempt_number+1 and retry_of_delivery_id. For an inbound SMS the single row records receipt from the provider (status delivered). failure_reason must be redacted; never store message bodies or credentials.

| Column | Type | Required | Default | Key / reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | gen_random_uuid() | PK |
| `message_id` | uuid | yes |  | FK → messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `attempt_number` | smallint | yes | 1 |  |
| `retry_of_delivery_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → message_deliveries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `channel` | text | yes |  |  |
| `provider_configuration_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → provider_configurations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `recipient_user_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `recipient_phone` | e164 | no |  |  |
| `status` | text | yes | 'queued'::text |  |
| `provider_status` | text | no |  |  |
| `provider_message_id` | text | no |  |  |
| `is_simulated` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `failure_class` | text | no |  |  |
| `is_permanent` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `failure_code` | text | no |  |  |
| `failure_reason` | text | no |  |  |
| `http_status` | smallint | no |  |  |
| `status_version` | integer | yes | 1 |  |
| `next_attempt_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `locked_until` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `started_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `accepted_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `sent_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `delivered_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `read_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `terminal_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |

**Unique rules**

- `uq_deliveries_message_attempt`: `UNIQUE (message_id, attempt_number)`
- `uq_deliveries_provider_message`: `USING btree (provider_configuration_id, provider_message_id) WHERE (provider_message_id IS NOT NULL)`

**Check constraints**

- `ck_deliveries_attempt`: `((attempt_number >= 1))`
- `ck_deliveries_channel`: `((channel = ANY (ARRAY['chikka'::text, 'sms'::text])))`
- `ck_deliveries_chikka`: `(((channel = 'sms'::text) OR ((provider_configuration_id IS NULL) AND (provider_message_id IS NULL) AND (NOT is_simulated) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['sent'::text, 'delivered'::text, 'read'::text, 'failed'::text])))))`
- `ck_deliveries_failed_has_class`: `(((status <> 'failed'::text) OR (failure_class IS NOT NULL)))`
- `ck_deliveries_failure_class`: `(((failure_class IS NULL) OR (failure_class = ANY (ARRAY['policy'::text, 'transient'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'permanent'::text, 'configuration'::text]))))`
- `ck_deliveries_failure_reason`: `(((failure_reason IS NULL) OR (char_length(failure_reason) <= 500)))`
- `ck_deliveries_permanent_terminal`: `(((NOT is_permanent) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'undelivered'::text]))))`
- `ck_deliveries_read_chikka`: `(((read_at IS NULL) OR (channel = 'chikka'::text)))`
- `ck_deliveries_recipient`: `(((recipient_user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (recipient_phone IS NOT NULL)))`
- `ck_deliveries_sms_provider`: `(((channel = 'chikka'::text) OR (provider_configuration_id IS NOT NULL)))`
- `ck_deliveries_status`: `((status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'accepted'::text, 'sent'::text, 'delivered'::text, 'read'::text, 'undelivered'::text, 'failed'::text])))`

**Foreign keys**

- `fk_deliveries_message`: `(message_id) REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `fk_deliveries_provider_cfg`: `(provider_configuration_id) REFERENCES provider_configurations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `fk_deliveries_recipient`: `(recipient_user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `fk_deliveries_retry_of`: `(retry_of_delivery_id) REFERENCES message_deliveries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`

**Indexes**

- `idx_deliveries_due`: `USING btree (next_attempt_at) WHERE ((status = 'queued'::text) AND (next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL))`
- `idx_deliveries_message`: `USING btree (message_id)`
- `idx_deliveries_recipient`: `USING btree (recipient_user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE (recipient_user_id IS NOT NULL)`
- `idx_deliveries_reconcile`: `USING btree (status, updated_at) WHERE ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'sent'::text])))`

**Triggers**

- `trg_deliveries_status_progress`: BEFORE UPDATE OF status → private.enforce_delivery_status_progress()
- `trg_deliveries_sync_message`: AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status, is_permanent → private.sync_message_status()
- `trg_deliveries_updated_at`: BEFORE UPDATE → private.set_updated_at()
- `trg_deliveries_validate_insert`: BEFORE INSERT → private.validate_delivery_insert()

**Row Level Security:** enabled. Policies: `deliveries_select_admin` (select), `deliveries_select_party` (select).

### `provider_webhooks`

**Purpose:** Raw verified callbacks. Contains message content for inbound events, so it is server-only. Retention: at least 90 days (purge_after), then purged by a scheduled job.

| Column | Type | Required | Default | Key / reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | gen_random_uuid() | PK |
| `provider` | text | yes |  |  |
| `provider_configuration_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → provider_configurations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `kind` | text | yes |  |  |
| `dedupe_key` | text | yes |  |  |
| `provider_message_id` | text | no |  |  |
| `raw_payload` | jsonb | yes |  |  |
| `signature_verified_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |
| `is_simulated` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `processing_status` | text | yes | 'received'::text |  |
| `process_attempts` | smallint | yes | 0 |  |
| `next_process_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `processed_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `error_code` | text | no |  |  |
| `routing_result` | text | no |  |  |
| `delivery_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → message_deliveries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `message_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `received_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |
| `purge_after` | timestamp with time zone | yes | (now() + '90 days'::interval) |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |

**Unique rules**

- `uq_webhooks_dedupe`: `UNIQUE (provider, kind, dedupe_key)`

**Check constraints**

- `ck_webhooks_attempts`: `((process_attempts >= 0))`
- `ck_webhooks_kind`: `((kind = ANY (ARRAY['status'::text, 'inbound'::text])))`
- `ck_webhooks_payload_object`: `((jsonb_typeof(raw_payload) = 'object'::text))`
- `ck_webhooks_payload_size`: `((octet_length((raw_payload)::text) <= 65536))`
- `ck_webhooks_processing`: `((processing_status = ANY (ARRAY['received'::text, 'processed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'ignored'::text, 'orphaned'::text])))`
- `ck_webhooks_provider`: `((provider ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'::text))`
- `ck_webhooks_routing`: `(((routing_result IS NULL) OR (routing_result = ANY (ARRAY['routed'::text, 'unrouted'::text, 'opt_out'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'duplicate'::text, 'suppressed'::text]))))`

**Foreign keys**

- `fk_webhooks_delivery`: `(delivery_id) REFERENCES message_deliveries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
- `fk_webhooks_message`: `(message_id) REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
- `fk_webhooks_provider_cfg`: `(provider_configuration_id) REFERENCES provider_configurations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`

**Indexes**

- `idx_webhooks_pending`: `USING btree (next_process_at) WHERE (processing_status = ANY (ARRAY['received'::text, 'failed'::text, 'orphaned'::text]))`
- `idx_webhooks_provider_message`: `USING btree (provider, provider_message_id) WHERE (provider_message_id IS NOT NULL)`
- `idx_webhooks_purge`: `USING btree (purge_after)`
- `idx_webhooks_unrouted`: `USING btree (received_at DESC) WHERE (routing_result = 'unrouted'::text)`

**Triggers**

- `trg_webhooks_updated_at`: BEFORE UPDATE → private.set_updated_at()

**Row Level Security:** enabled. No policies: no client access (server-only).

### `sms_routes`

| `status` | text | yes | 'active'::text |  |
| `last_outbound_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |
| `expires_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | (now() + '30 days'::interval) |  |
| `released_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `release_reason` | text | no |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |

| `opted_in_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |

| `lift_reason` | text | no |  |  |

**Unique rules**

**Check constraints**

- `ck_opt_outs_lift_source`: `(((lift_source IS NULL) OR (lift_source = ANY (ARRAY['recipient_keyword'::text, 'admin'::text]))))`

### `sms_country_capabilities`

| Column | Type | Required | Default | Key / reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | gen_random_uuid() | PK |
| `country_code` | character(2) | yes |  |  |
| `country_name` | text | yes |  |  |
| `version` | integer | yes | 1 |  |
| `is_current` | boolean | yes | true |  |
| `effective_from` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |
| `outbound_support` | text | yes | 'unsupported'::text |  |
| `inbound_support` | text | yes | 'unsupported'::text |  |
| `alphanumeric_sender_allowed` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `registered_sender_required` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `registered_sender_status` | text | yes | 'not_required'::text |  |
| `content_restrictions` | text | no |  |  |
| `credit_multiplier` | numeric(8,4) | yes | 1 |  |
| `max_segments` | smallint | yes | 10 |  |
| `notes` | text | no |  |  |
| `verified_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  |
| `verified_by` | uuid | no |  | FK → profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `created_by` | uuid | no |  | FK → profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |

**Unique rules**

- `uq_sms_cap_country_version`: `UNIQUE (country_code, version)`
- `uq_sms_cap_current`: `USING btree (country_code) WHERE is_current`

**Check constraints**

- `ck_sms_cap_country`: `((country_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'::text))`
- `ck_sms_cap_inbound`: `((inbound_support = ANY (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'requires_verification'::text, 'supported'::text])))`
- `ck_sms_cap_multiplier`: `((credit_multiplier > (0)::numeric))`
- `ck_sms_cap_outbound`: `((outbound_support = ANY (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'requires_verification'::text, 'supported'::text])))`
- `ck_sms_cap_ph_registration`: `(((country_code <> 'PH'::bpchar) OR (registered_sender_status <> 'not_required'::text)))`
- `ck_sms_cap_registered_for_support`: `(((NOT ((outbound_support = 'supported'::text) AND registered_sender_required)) OR (registered_sender_status = 'registered'::text)))`
- `ck_sms_cap_registration`: `((registered_sender_status = ANY (ARRAY['not_required'::text, 'not_registered'::text, 'pending'::text, 'registered'::text])))`
- `ck_sms_cap_segments`: `(((max_segments >= 1) AND (max_segments <= 10)))`
- `ck_sms_cap_verified_for_support`: `((((outbound_support <> 'supported'::text) AND (inbound_support <> 'supported'::text)) OR ((verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (verified_by IS NOT NULL))))`
- `ck_sms_cap_version`: `((version >= 1))`

**Foreign keys**

- `fk_sms_cap_created_by`: `(created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
- `fk_sms_cap_verified_by`: `(verified_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`

**Triggers**

- `trg_sms_cap_updated_at`: BEFORE UPDATE → private.set_updated_at()

**Row Level Security:** enabled. Policies: `sms_cap_insert_admin` (insert), `sms_cap_select_admin` (select), `sms_cap_select_current` (select), `sms_cap_update_admin` (update).

## Credits

### `messaging_credits`

**Purpose:** Current balance per user and ledger. Derived state: always equals the sum of credit_transactions. Available = balance_units - reserved_units.

| Column | Type | Required | Default | Key / reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | uuid | yes |  | PK; FK → profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `ledger_type` | text | yes |  | PK |
| `balance_units` | bigint | yes | 0 |  |
| `reserved_units` | bigint | yes | 0 |  |
| `low_balance_alerted` | boolean | yes | false |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |

**Check constraints**

- `ck_credits_balance`: `((balance_units >= 0))`
- `ck_credits_ledger`: `((ledger_type = ANY (ARRAY['live'::text, 'demo'::text])))`
- `ck_credits_reserved`: `((reserved_units >= 0))`
- `ck_credits_reserved_within_balance`: `((reserved_units <= balance_units))`

**Foreign keys**

- `fk_credits_user`: `(user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`

**Triggers**

- `trg_credits_updated_at`: BEFORE UPDATE → private.set_updated_at()

**Row Level Security:** enabled. Policies: `credits_select_admin` (select), `credits_select_own` (select).

### `credit_transactions`

**Purpose:** Append-only ledger. balance_after and reserved_after are filled by trigger. Every send-related entry records message, provider, country, segments and the capability version (rate) used.

| Column | Type | Required | Default | Key / reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | gen_random_uuid() | PK |
| `user_id` | uuid | yes |  | FK → messaging_credits(user_id, ledger_type) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `ledger_type` | text | yes |  | FK → messaging_credits(user_id, ledger_type) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `entry_type` | text | yes |  |  |
| `balance_delta` | bigint | yes |  |  |
| `reserved_delta` | bigint | yes | 0 |  |
| `balance_after` | bigint | no |  |  |
| `reserved_after` | bigint | no |  |  |
| `message_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → messages(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `capability_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → sms_country_capabilities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `provider` | text | no |  |  |
| `country_code` | character(2) | no |  |  |
| `segment_count` | smallint | no |  |  |
| `external_reference` | text | no |  |  |
| `reason` | text | no |  |  |
| `actor_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |

**Unique rules**

- `uq_credit_tx_message_entry`: `USING btree (message_id, entry_type) WHERE (message_id IS NOT NULL)`
- `uq_credit_tx_external_reference`: `USING btree (external_reference) WHERE (external_reference IS NOT NULL)`

**Check constraints**

- `ck_credit_tx_adjustment_audit`: `(((entry_type <> 'adjustment'::text) OR ((reason IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(btrim(reason)) > 0) AND (actor_id IS NOT NULL))))`
- `ck_credit_tx_country`: `(((country_code IS NULL) OR (country_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'::text)))`
- `ck_credit_tx_demo_no_topup`: `(((ledger_type = 'live'::text) OR (entry_type <> 'top_up'::text)))`
- `ck_credit_tx_entry_shape`: `((((entry_type = 'grant'::text) AND (balance_delta > 0) AND (reserved_delta = 0)) OR ((entry_type = 'top_up'::text) AND (balance_delta > 0) AND (reserved_delta = 0)) OR ((entry_type = 'reservation'::text) AND (balance_delta = 0) AND (reserved_delta > 0)) OR ((entry_type = 'reservation_release'::text) AND (balance_delta = 0) AND (reserved_delta < 0)) OR ((entry_type = 'deduction'::text) AND (balance_delta < 0) AND (reserved_delta <= 0)) OR ((entry_type = 'refund'::text) AND (balance_delta > 0) AND (reserved_delta = 0)) OR ((entry_type = 'adjustment'::text) AND (balance_delta <> 0) AND (reserved_delta = 0))))`
- `ck_credit_tx_message_required`: `(((entry_type <> ALL (ARRAY['reservation'::text, 'reservation_release'::text, 'deduction'::text, 'refund'::text])) OR (message_id IS NOT NULL)))`
- `ck_credit_tx_segments`: `(((segment_count IS NULL) OR ((segment_count >= 1) AND (segment_count <= 10))))`

**Foreign keys**

- `fk_credit_tx_account`: `(user_id, ledger_type) REFERENCES messaging_credits(user_id, ledger_type) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `fk_credit_tx_actor`: `(actor_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `fk_credit_tx_capability`: `(capability_id) REFERENCES sms_country_capabilities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `fk_credit_tx_message`: `(message_id) REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`

**Indexes**

- `idx_credit_tx_user`: `USING btree (user_id, ledger_type, created_at DESC)`

**Triggers**

- `trg_credit_tx_apply`: BEFORE INSERT → private.apply_credit_transaction()
- `trg_credit_tx_immutable`: BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE → private.reject_mutation()

**Row Level Security:** enabled. Policies: `credit_tx_select_admin` (select), `credit_tx_select_own` (select).

### `notifications`

**Purpose:** In-app notification feed. Removed after 90 days (expires_at, purged by a scheduled job). body is null when the user disabled previews.

| Column | Type | Required | Default | Key / reference |

**Triggers**

- `trg_rate_limit_updated_at`: BEFORE UPDATE → private.set_updated_at()

**Row Level Security:** enabled. No policies: no client access (server-only).

### `audit_logs`

**Purpose:** Append-only. Rows can be deleted only after retain_until (SMS audit entries: at least 90 days). Security events should set a longer retain_until per policy. Server-only.

| Column | Type | Required | Default | Key / reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | gen_random_uuid() | PK |
| `category` | text | yes |  |  |
| `action` | text | yes |  |  |
| `outcome` | text | yes | 'success'::text |  |
| `actor_id` | uuid | no |  | FK → profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `actor_role` | text | no |  |  |
| `target_type` | text | no |  |  |
| `target_id` | text | no |  |  |
| `reason` | text | no |  |  |
| `request_id` | text | no |  |  |
| `ip_prefix` | text | no |  |  |
| `metadata` | jsonb | yes | '{}'::jsonb |  |
| `retain_until` | timestamp with time zone | yes | (now() + '90 days'::interval) |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes | now() |  |

**Check constraints**

- `ck_audit_action`: `((action ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$'::text))`
- `ck_audit_category`: `((category = ANY (ARRAY['auth'::text, 'admin'::text, 'sms'::text, 'credit'::text, 'consent'::text, 'privacy'::text, 'security'::text, 'moderation'::text, 'system'::text])))`
- `ck_audit_metadata_keys`: `((NOT (metadata ?| ARRAY['body'::text, 'message'::text, 'text'::text, 'content'::text, 'password'::text, 'token'::text, 'secret'::text, 'otp'::text, 'authorization'::text])))`
- `ck_audit_metadata_object`: `((jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object'::text))`
- `ck_audit_no_phone`: `(((NOT private.contains_unmasked_phone((metadata)::text)) AND (NOT private.contains_unmasked_phone(target_id)) AND (NOT private.contains_unmasked_phone(reason))))`
- `ck_audit_outcome`: `((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['success'::text, 'denied'::text, 'failure'::text])))`

**Foreign keys**

- `fk_audit_actor`: `(actor_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`

**Indexes**

- `idx_audit_actor`: `USING btree (actor_id, created_at DESC) WHERE (actor_id IS NOT NULL)`
- `idx_audit_category`: `USING btree (category, created_at DESC)`
- `idx_audit_created`: `USING btree (created_at DESC)`
- `idx_audit_retention`: `USING btree (retain_until)`
- `idx_audit_target`: `USING btree (target_type, target_id) WHERE (target_id IS NOT NULL)`

**Triggers**

- `trg_audit_protect`: BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE → private.protect_audit_logs()

**Row Level Security:** enabled. No policies: no client access (server-only).
